thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: smart-routing fallback errors detected in production. Escalation level: P1.

alyssa_oncall: got the page, I'm on it. seeing increased 502 spikes and fallback churn across us-west/us-east. paging SRE.

james_sre: oncall here. adding logs. any changes pushed recently to routing config?

megan_ml: we shipped a config-schema update in the last deploy window that deprecated `route_priority` in favor of `route_weights`. there was a migration shim. cc @karim_platform

karim_platform: yep that migration went out 03:22UTC. migration maps old `route_priority` -> `default_fallback` for backwards compatibility.

alyssa_oncall: can we confirm whether the shim can set an implicit fallback variant?

megan_ml: looking at the migration code now. quick snippet:

```py
# migration logic (simplified)
if payload.get('route_priority') and not payload.get('route_weights'):
    payload['route_weights'] = translate_priority_to_weights(payload['route_priority'])
    # legacy path: set fallback_variant if highest priority missing
    if 'fallback_variant' not in payload:
        payload['fallback_variant'] = legacy_default_for(payload['route_priority'])
```

james_sre: that "legacy_default_for" looks suspicious. can we grep recent routing logs to see fallback picks?

alyssa_oncall: grabbing logs...

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T03:22Z routing-config-migration succeeded on fleet-23 :white_check_mark:

alyssa_oncall: logs show a repeated pattern: requests to model-id:open-embed-32 are being routed to variant `vX-small` in us-west, fail, then auto-fallback to us-east `vY-medium`, then routed back to us-west. loop every ~8s. sample trace: 

```
[03:28:14] request 0x9a3 -> model open-embed-32@vX-small (us-west) -> 502 timeout
[03:28:22] fallback -> model open-embed-32@vY-medium (us-east) -> 200 ok
[03:28:30] router re-evaluates -> prefers us-west -> choose vX-small again
```

megan_ml: that fits: migration set fallback_variant to a smaller/cheaper legacy variant that isn't healthy on certain racks. the router's penalty/recovery logic triggers repeated oscillation when fallback is unhealthy but preferred region policy nudges back.

karim_platform: we need a mitigation: disable migration defaults, lock routing policy to current stable mapping, or pause auto-fallback. suggestions?\

james_sre: immediate: disable auto-fallback for affected model group and freeze routing decisions. I can push a policy flag to stop fallback in ~2min.

alyssa_oncall: do it and post the exact CLI/command so others can audit.

james_sre: running:

```bash
redwoodctl routing update --model open-embed-32 --policy freeze --disable-auto-fallback true --comment "temp mitigate oscillation 2233334444"
```

james_sre: command returned 202. changes propagating to control plane.

alyssa_oncall: seeing immediate drop in fallback churn and 502s normalizing. timeline: max error-rate spike ~03:29-03:35UTC; after freeze errors dropped ~90%.

emily_cs: notified top 5 affected customers (acme-corp, finmetrics, chatly, docsprint, edu-net) at 03:36UTC with ETA for full mitigation. CS notes: several customer requests experienced degraded quality, some retried. no data loss.

paul_product: did any canaries or tests show this earlier? we should add preflight checks for migration shims.

megan_ml: root cause summary: migration shim (deprecating `route_priority`) populated `fallback_variant` implicitly for legacy configs. that default pointed at a small variant that doesn't satisfy production latency on certain racks; combined with region-preference routing this created oscillatory failover.

karim_platform: follow-ups: 1) revert migration defaults (rollback migration commit ID: 2b7f9c3), 2) make migration opt-in behind feature flag, 3) add a validation that fallback_variant must meet SLA profile, 4) add circuit breaker to prevent oscillation loops.

alyssa_oncall: action items assigned: james_sre rollback migration defaults (do now, then confirm), megan_ml add validation & unit tests, karim_platform add feature-flag gating, paul_product own postmortem and customer comm template, emily_cs continue customer updates.

james_sre: rolling back migration commit 2b7f9c3 -> running revert.

deploy-bot: rollback deploy started 03:41:10Z for routing-migration (initiated by james_sre)

james_sre: rollback completed 03:43:02Z. control plane reports legacy fallback_variant entries removed for configs where route_weights existed.

alyssa_oncall: monitoring: error rate stable and region fallback oscillation stopped. closing the immediate pager.

IncidentBot: Incident marked as resolved at 03:49UTC. Postmortem required.

megan_ml: will open PR with validation & tests, will also add an integration test simulating unhealthy variant to catch oscillation.

paul_product: I'll draft customer-facing note summarizing impact, mitigation, and ETA for permanent fixes.

emily_cs: customers updated. no outstanding escalations.

alyssa_oncall: thanks all. we'll follow up in the postmortem thread. :thumbsup:
